title: Saffra · all ten at 3×
caption: Ten brand-new designs beside the CC0 pawn and knight. Judge: which two or three are Saffra?

title: Saffra · at game size

title: 3. Field Burner · five props
caption: Five props in place of the torch, all clear of the brim. Judge: which one says field-burning spice broker?

title: 3.1 Field Burner · Ember Pot
caption: She carries the fire to the field in a brass ember pot on a chain, swung low at her knee; it smokes while she talks price. The idle and the prop’s tic, looped. Judge: does the tic say who she is?

title: 3.2 Field Burner · Bellows
caption: A leather hand bellows at her side for fanning the burn along the rows; she squeezes it and it spits sparks. The idle and the prop’s tic, looped. Judge: does the tic say who she is?

title: 3.3 Field Burner · Pepper Ristra
caption: A string of the summer’s dried red peppers hanging from her fist, the sample she shows every buyer. The idle and the prop’s tic, looped. Judge: does the tic say who she is?

title: 3.4 Field Burner · Fire Beater
caption: A birch-twig fire beater held low and angled away, for slapping out the burn where it jumps the furrow. The idle and the prop’s tic, looped. Judge: does the tic say who she is?

title: 3.5 Field Burner · Smoked Sack
caption: A sack of the smoked pepper the burn leaves behind, swung from her fist, stamped with the company pepper. The idle and the prop’s tic, looped. Judge: does the tic say who she is?
